01. Make your mark.

Add a question, image, or sketch beside the passage it belongs to.

  1. Text

    Right-click a passage, choose + T, and type. Enter saves; Shift+Enter adds a line. The saved note stays in the separate collaboration layer.

  2. Images

    Choose the image tool for Photos, Stickers, or Draw. Upload a photo, paste an image, or select the planning sticker. Large raster photos are resized locally.

  3. Drawing

    Inside Draw, use pen, rectangle, ellipse, and color. Lasso fully enclosed marks to move them. Use drawing exports a transparent image; save it as an annotation.

Drawing currently happens in the picker, not directly over the page. On phones, the annotation panel is also available without right-clicking.

02. Keep the context.

Document content and annotations are different things. A comment can challenge a paragraph without silently changing it.

The documentA versioned account of the current plan.

The discussionEncrypted notes, images, and drawing assets.

Live contributions synchronize through Convex after encryption on the device. Each note retains its document target and author/session attribution.

Link-only notes open in a new tab. Automatic previews are not available yet.

Read feedback before writing the next version

Read the document and accessible annotations together. Record what was incorporated, deferred, or needs clarification. Preserve original notes and targets; do not treat every comment as an instruction.

03. Bring your agent.

A bot can become a decryption recipient through its own wallet identity. The publishing operator adds its public key and shares a new version. Its private key stays inside its local wallet tooling.

All subagents, use this link to collaborate on our BitPlan:
[COLLABORATION INVITATION]

Read the current document and annotations first.
Use a distinct agent session. Preserve others’ contributions.
Explain which feedback your proposed revision addresses.

Keep complete reader links and collaboration invitations private. Anyone holding a reader link can read; a collaboration invitation also allows contributions.

Share with contacts instead of a reader link

Ask your agent to verify a contact's public identity key with you, save the contact, and create a new hosted plan encrypted to that contact and your wallet. Do not share a private key or wallet password.

npx bitplan contact set dave <verified-public-identity-key>
npx bitplan contact list
npx bitplan upload ./private-plan.html --hosted --share-with dave

Use a new plan file for this example. Existing drafts can retain earlier reader-link recipients; omitting --link does not revoke them. Contacts are local labels. Decryption permission does not grant publishing authority or replace the live collaboration invitation.

04. Keep the record.

Hosted versions

Publishing this hosted edition advances the plan’s version selector without a blockchain transaction. A shared-room edit alone does not create that new version.

Annotation checkpoints — planned

The intended checkpoint will preserve the images and drawings as encrypted assets tied to an exact document version. Combined document/layer inscription and chain-only reconstruction are not enabled yet.

05. What remains.

Direct-on-document drawing; safe remote unfurls; deletion of owned annotations; revision requests with owner review; and on-chain annotation publishing/recovery.

What changed in this edition

Removed repeated branding, all-caps labels, and redundant captions. Kept the editorial layout, useful instructions, and local examples.

BitPlan · OPL

A document you can build on.

The page is HTML, not a flattened picture. Put a question beside a sentence, draw around a chart, or ask your agent to propose a new section as an HTML overlay.

01 / The document

Readable text, diagrams, images, and local data. Each section is a place to discuss a specific idea.

02 / Your contributions

Text edits, notes, drawings, and HTML widgets live in attributed layers. In a connected room, saved changes appear for other readers.

03 / The next version

Review the layers in Publish, choose what to consider, and copy the agent prompt. A hosted revision gets a new version; recording on chain is a separate, deliberate step.

Make the evidence visible.

Two ways to inspect a review: how notes accumulated, and what kinds of contributions arrived. These are illustrative local datasets, not BitPlan analytics or this room’s activity.

Try it: expand a data table and edit a number in the live viewer. The chart redraws locally from those cells. Only the viewer’s saved text edits are shared; these charts do not query your room, wallet, or contacts. Replace sample values and source labels with your project’s evidence.
